caption: The drawing depicts a formal garden scene with a large two-story house at the center background. The house is light pink with white trim and has symmetrical windows, a blue triangular roof, and two small chimneys. In the middle foreground, a beige and light yellow path leads directly toward the house, dividing the green lawn into two sections. On either side of the path in the lower foreground, there are two rectangular terraced flower beds bordered with light brown edges; both beds contain red and pink flowers surrounded by green foliage. Beyond the main lawn and flower beds, the midground features a symmetrical formal garden with geometric paths and planting beds outlined in red-brown, including two square areas and a central circular pattern, all flanked by four evenly spaced trees with green foliage. Behind the garden, there is a pale blue fence that runs horizontally, separating the formal garden from the background. The background contains numerous green trees with layered, textured leaves in multiple shades of green, yellow, and some hints of purple, creating an enclosed, park-like setting. The sky above is light and blends to pale yellow at the top.
title: N.W. Stuyvesant Residence
